# AskPython

> AskPython is a comprehensive Python learning platform offering tutorials, guides, and resources for developers of all skill levels, from beginners to advanced practitioners.

Founded by Pankaj Kumar, AskPython provides free Python tutorials covering fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data science libraries (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy), machine learning, cryptocurrency trading, web automation, and modern AI integration topics like RAG and LLM applications.

## Key Topics

- Python Programming
- Object-Oriented Programming
- Python Fundamentals
- Data Science Libraries
- NumPy
- Pandas
- SciPy
- Machine Learning
- Signal Processing
- RAG Applications
- Cryptocurrency Trading
- Web Automation
- AI Integration
- FastFourierTransform
- Python Modules

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.askpython.com): AskPython homepage: Python tutorials, guides, and developer resources
- [Python Course for Beginners Online FREE](https://www.askpython.com/python-course-for-beginners): Free Python course for beginners with video tutorials and fundamentals
- [Python Tutorial - Mega Index](https://www.askpython.com/python-tutorial-index): Comprehensive Python tutorial index with basics, OOP, and libraries
- [Python Programming Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python): Python tutorials covering fundamentals, RAG, LLM, exception handling
- [Python Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python-programming): Python introduction: language history, features, and beginner guide

## Core Python Concepts

- [Object-Oriented Programming in Python](https://www.askpython.com/python/oops/object-oriented-programming-python): OOP fundamentals: classes, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation
- [Python OOPS Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python/oops): Python OOP tutorials: classes, decorators, magic methods, inheritance
- [Python String Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python/string): Python string manipulation: formatting, methods, encoding, StringIO
- [Python Programming Examples Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python/examples): Python examples: RAG applications, machine learning, data processing

## Libraries & Modules

- [Python Modules Tutorials](https://www.askpython.com/python-modules): Python modules guide: SciPy, NumPy, Pandas, and signal processing
- [scipy.fft: Fast Fourier Transform for Signal Analysis](https://www.askpython.com/python-modules/scipy/scipy-fft): scipy.fft module guide: FFT operations, frequency analysis, signal processing

## Advanced Applications

- [Introduction To Cryptocurrency Trading With Python](https://www.askpython.com/resources/introduction-to-cryptocurrency-trading-with-python): Cryptocurrency trading with Python: Freqtrade, CCXT, Binance integration
- [Automating Screenshot Generation for Web Applications in Python](https://www.askpython.com/resources/automating-screenshot-generation-for-web-applications-in-python): Web automation with Selenium, Playwright: screenshot generation and testing
